entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A planeswalker who returns to Theros to become the god of revels and ascends into Nyx.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: The god of slaughter who sends minotaur hordes against the human cities.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads heroes to break the minotaur siege at Akros and is blamed for Xenagos' ascension.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who has a planeswalker card in the set.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The realm of enchantment whose boundary with mortal existence grows thin.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A human city besieged by minotaurs.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A human city targeted by the minotaurs.

entities.name: Setessa
entities.description: A human city targeted by the minotaurs.

entities.name: Nyxborn
entities.description: Strange creatures of enchantment pouring into the mortal world.

events.summary: Xenagos returns to Theros to become the god of revels as the boundary with Nyx thins and Nyxborn pour into the mortal world.
events.quote: the planeswalker Xenagos returns to Theros to become the god of revels.

events.summary: Mogis sends hordes of minotaurs against Akros, Meletis and Setessa.
events.quote: Mogis , the god of slaughter sends hordes of mortal and Nyxborn minotaurs against the human cities Akros , Meletis , and Setessa .

events.summary: Elspeth leads an army of heroes to break the minotaur siege at Akros.
events.quote: Elspeth Tirel leads an army of heroes to break the minotaur siege at Akros.

events.summary: The victory celebration becomes the ritual that launches Xenagos into Nyx as a god; Elspeth is blamed and driven away.
events.quote: Elspeth is blamed for his ascension and driven away in disgrace.

relations.quote: sends hordes of mortal and Nyxborn minotaurs against the human cities Akros

relations.note: Leads heroes against his minotaur siege.
